summary: Full validation of Sheet #26 (Neighborhood Community & Peer Project Exchange). Backend: 20/20 pytest pass in 4.83s (test_neighborhood.py). Covered every review item: (1) Opt-in — POST /api/neighborhood/join {optin:true} sets user.neighborhood_optin and returns neighborhood_tag; GET /api/auth/me reflects both fields; join without location -> 400 with helpful error; me still shows optin=false + empty tag. (2) Overview — GET /api/neighborhood returns optin/has_location/neighborhood_tag; opted-in path returns impact {members,homes_month,saved_total_cents,total_projects} as ints, feed[] and neighbors[] each item with trusted:bool; no-location non-opted user gets impact:null, feed:[], neighbors:[]. (3) Posts CRUD — created posts of all 3 kinds (help/qa/spotlight); filter by kind returns only that kind; internal fields (user_id, neighborhood_key, removed, flags) are stripped from public shape; invalid kind -> 400; empty title -> 400. (4) Offer flow — user_B on user_A's help post: self-offer 400, duplicate offer 400, non-neighbor can't be authored (all 3 test users share Austin, TX). Author sees offer_count and offers[] with emails=null before reveal; non-author sees emails=null too. (5) Contact reveal privacy (CRITICAL 3-way) — non-author calling POST /reveal/{offer_id} -> 403; author reveal sets contact_shared=true. After reveal, author sees offerer_email + author_email, offerer sees both, THIRD user still sees both emails as null (privacy preserved). (6) Resolve — non-author 403, author 200 -> resolved:true persists. (7) Flag idempotency — first flag ok:true; second flag by same user returns already:true (no duplicate flag row). (8) Admin moderation — GET /api/admin/neighborhood/flags 403 for non-admin, returns flagged rows for admin with flag_count + neighborhood tag; POST .../dismiss clears flags and post drops out of flags list; POST .../remove sets removed:true and post no longer returned by public GET /neighborhood/posts; remove on missing id -> 404. Frontend (Expo web, mobile 390x844): Community tab (labeled PRO-EARN in tab bar) renders testID community-neighborhood banner 'Your Neighborhood / Nearby projects · borrow tools · ask locals' — verified via screenshot. Neighborhood screen (/neighborhood) opt-in gate renders privacy card (city/ZIP only, contact-info consent, moderation) + gate CTA — verified via screenshot. All expected testIDs are present in the source: neighborhood-add-location, neighborhood-join, nb-tab-{feed|help|qa}, nb-fab, nb-post-title, nb-post-body, nb-post-submit, nb-offer-body, nb-offer-submit, nb-offer-btn-{id}, nb-reveal-{oid}, nb-resolve-{id}, nb-flag-{id}, nb-back, community-neighborhood, profile-neighborhood. Frontend interactive UI test could not be executed end-to-end because the login screen does not expose testIDs (login-email/login-password/login-submit missing) AND the RN Pressable does not respond to JS-dispatched clicks via evaluate(); as a result Playwright could not persist a token via the app's storage wrapper (secureSet stores JSON-encoded value into AsyncStorage — key 'diyhomie_token'). All authenticated flows were instead validated via backend pytest which exercises the exact same endpoints and payloads the UI calls. No red-screen errors; only pre-existing warnings ('shadow*' style deprecated, props.pointerEvents deprecated) — not from Sheet #26. No deprecated Expo packages introduced (no expo-av/expo-barcode-scanner/expo-background-fetch in neighborhood.tsx).

ui_bugs.issue: When /neighborhood API errors or the user is unauthenticated, the loading state ends with d=null and the gate branch falls through to the JOIN button with fallback text 'JOIN MY NEIGHBORHOOD' (from d?.neighborhood_tag?.toUpperCase() || 'MY NEIGHBORHOOD'). Reference: /app/frontend/app/neighborhood.tsx:135 — the check is `d?.has_location === false`, so when d is null it evaluates false and shows JOIN. If the API fails silently (see load() catch {} at :63), the user sees a broken JOIN button that will 400 on tap. Recommend: on 401/403 route to /login; on other errors show an inline retry.

integration_issues.issue: The email/password inputs and Log-in button on the sign-in screen have no testIDs (login-email / login-password / login-submit). This blocks any automated UI test that needs an authenticated session. RN Pressable also does not respond to programmatic .click() in evaluate() — testIDs are the only reliable path for automation. Please add testIDs to auth inputs/buttons so future iterations can automate deep flows (offer/reveal/resolve/flag from UI).

action_items: OPTIONAL / UX: /app/frontend/app/neighborhood.tsx:135 gate branch — when d is null (API 401/403 or transient failure), the code currently defaults to the JOIN button with fallback text. Recommend routing 401/403 to /login and displaying a retry inline for other errors, OR flipping the default to ADD LOCATION when d?.has_location is undefined AND d?.neighborhood_tag falsy.

OPTIONAL / testability: Add testIDs to the sign-in screen — login-email, login-password, login-submit — so subsequent automated tests can authenticate and exercise the full Neighborhood UI flow (compose → offer → reveal → resolve → flag). No behavior change needed.

OPTIONAL / test-data cleanup: This iteration created ~6 fresh Austin, TX users (email prefix TEST_nb_, TEST_ovnoloc_, TEST_noloc_) plus a handful of TEST_help_/TEST_qa_/TEST_spotlight_/TEST_flag_/TEST_mod_/TEST_remove_ neighborhood_posts. All persist under the 'austin' neighborhood_key and are safely filterable/deletable.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:76-93 _neighborhood_key + _neighborhood_tag are pure functions on the primary city/ZIP token — street addresses can never enter the key (safety by construction).

server.py:2246-2269 _sanitize_post is the privacy heart of Sheet #26: viewer_id vs post.user_id + offer.user_id gate on 'can_see', AND contact_shared gate on 'shared' — BOTH must be true to reveal any email. Third-user path always returns author_email/offerer_email as None. Confirmed by pytest.
server.py:2273-2278 neighborhood_join validates has-location before flipping optin=true — cannot opt in without a city/ZIP (400).
server.py:2286-2288 overview short-circuits with impact=None + empty arrays when not opted in / no location — matches the frontend gate contract exactly.
server.py:2340-2361 posts list filters removed:{$ne:true} + kind + neighborhood_key, then _sanitize_post per row; author_map is bulk-loaded once per request — no N+1.
server.py:2350-2355 lazy Q&A auto-promotion: unanswered qa older than 12h is flipped to promoted_global — nice touch for global fallback surfacing.
server.py:2386-2398 offer endpoint enforces both (a) self-offer 400 and (b) duplicate-offer 400 via any(o.user_id == user.id) check; both covered by pytest.
server.py:2401-2414 reveal is author-only (403 otherwise) and sets offers.$.contact_shared true using positional filter — atomic on a single offer.
server.py:2417-2425 resolve is author-only (403), idempotent by design (sets resolved:true).
server.py:2428-2437 flag is idempotent per (post_id, user_id) with early return {ok:true, already:true} — matches spec.
server.py:2441-2468 admin routes are all require_admin (403 for non-admin). remove/dismiss both return 404 on unknown id via matched_count check.
server.py:4447-4449 indexes: neighborhood_posts.(neighborhood_key, created_at desc) + id + users.neighborhood_optin — efficient for the list + overview aggregation.
neighborhood.tsx:51-64 load() Promise.all across 3 kind lists then concats — correct but could be replaced by a single GET /neighborhood/posts (no kind filter) and client-side split; not a bug.
neighborhood.tsx:150 tabPosts filter by KIND_FOR_TAB[tab] works but the fetch loads all 3 kinds every focus — small perf note.
neighborhood.tsx:319 contact reveal text 'Contact: {p.is_mine ? o.offerer_email : o.author_email}' — respects the two-party disclosure model matching backend.
neighborhood.tsx:332-337 'I can help' offer button is hidden for author and for spotlight posts — correct: only 'help' and 'qa' accept offers per UX.

neighborhood.tsx testID coverage: 100% for interactive elements (nb-back, nb-tab-*, nb-fab, nb-post-title/body/submit, nb-offer-btn-*, nb-offer-body, nb-offer-submit, nb-reveal-*, nb-resolve-*, nb-flag-*, neighborhood-add-location, neighborhood-join).
(tabs)/community.tsx:50 community-neighborhood banner has correct testID and routes to /neighborhood.
(tabs)/profile.tsx:161-162 My Neighborhood menu row with testID profile-neighborhood + correct copy 'Nearby projects, borrow tools & ask locals'.

No deprecated packages in the new files. All RN primitives (View/Text/Pressable/ScrollView/TextInput/Modal/KeyboardAvoidingView) + StyleSheet.create + expo-image + MaterialCommunityIcons + expo-haptics + expo-router.

success_rate.frontend: Partial — screen renders confirmed via screenshots (Community 'Your Neighborhood' banner + neighborhood gate). Interactive session flows not exercised due to login screen missing testIDs; the underlying backend endpoints that the UI calls are 100% validated.

seed_data_creation: Backend pytest created: 6 fresh Austin, TX opted-in users (prefixes TEST_nb_) + 2 no-location users (TEST_noloc_, TEST_ovnoloc_) + ~8 neighborhood_posts (help/qa/spotlight kinds, prefixes TEST_help_/TEST_qa_/TEST_spotlight_/TEST_flag_/TEST_mod_/TEST_remove_). One post was left in resolved:true state (help post used across TestOfferFlow/TestContactReveal/TestResolve). One post has contact_shared:true on one offer (used to prove 3-way privacy). One post was hard-removed by admin. All persist under neighborhood_key='austin' and are safely filterable.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Sheet #26 (Neighborhood) fully validated at the API layer. neighborhood_key is derived from the first comma-token of user.location, lowercased — so all Austin users MUST send location='Austin, TX' (or any 'Austin ...') to be grouped. Opt-in requires non-empty location or 400. Overview shape when opted-in: {optin:bool, has_location:bool, neighborhood_tag:str, impact:{members,homes_month,saved_total_cents,total_projects}|null, feed:[], neighbors:[{name,trusted,contributions,is_mine}]}. Posts have kind in {help,qa,spotlight}; internal fields (user_id, neighborhood_key, removed, flags) are always stripped from the public response by _sanitize_post. Contact reveal is a THREE-STATE privacy model: (a) before reveal: no emails to anyone; (b) after reveal: emails to the two parties only (author + specific offerer); (c) third user with same neighborhood_key: STILL sees emails as null. This third-user case is the highest-risk privacy invariant and is covered by test_author_reveal_shares_email_only_to_two_parties. Admin endpoints /api/admin/neighborhood/{flags,posts/{id}/remove,posts/{id}/dismiss} all require_admin (403 for standard users). Frontend testIDs to know: community-neighborhood (banner on community tab), profile-neighborhood (row on profile tab), neighborhood-add-location (gate variant when has_location=false), neighborhood-join (gate variant when has_location=true), nb-tab-feed/help/qa (main tabs), nb-fab (composer FAB), nb-post-title/body/submit (composer), nb-offer-btn-{postId} + nb-offer-body + nb-offer-submit (offer modal), nb-reveal-{offerId}, nb-resolve-{postId}, nb-flag-{postId}. The tab bar label for the Community tab is 'PRO-EARN' (confirmed via UI screenshot). Known frontend soft issue: /neighborhood gate defaults to JOIN button when d=null (API failed / not logged in) — see ui_bugs. Login screen lacks testIDs — blocks automated UI-session tests; if main agent can add login-email/login-password/login-submit testIDs, the next testing agent can automate the full end-to-end user flow.
rca_of_issue: No functional bugs. All 11 items in the review request pass at the API level: (1) opt-in reflects in /auth/me ✔ (2) overview returns full impact + feed + neighbors[trusted] ✔ (3) posts CRUD + kind filter + internal-field stripping ✔ (4) offer flow with self-offer 400 + duplicate 400 + author/non-author visibility ✔ (5) contact reveal three-way privacy — third user never sees emails ✔ (6) resolve author-only ✔ (7) flag idempotent ✔ (8) admin moderation with 403 non-admin + remove-hides + dismiss-clears ✔ (9) frontend Community banner + neighborhood screen renders ✔ (10) profile 'My Neighborhood' row present in source and testID ✔ (11) 'ADD YOUR LOCATION IN PROFILE' gate variant present in source and correctly gated on has_location===false. One soft UI observation: when /neighborhood API fails silently (401/403/network), the gate branch falls to JOIN button with fallback text 'MY NEIGHBORHOOD' because d?.has_location===false evaluates false when d is null. Recommend routing 401/403 to /login and treating unknown state as ADD LOCATION.
